title: Judah and Tamar

questions.question: Who was Judah's first son?
questions.explanation: Genesis 38:3 (ESV): "She conceived and bore a son, and he called his name Er."

questions.question: Why did God put Er to death?
questions.explanation: Genesis 38:7: "But Er, Judah's firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD, and the LORD put him to death."

questions.question: Who disguised herself to deceive Judah?
questions.explanation: Genesis 38:14: "She took off her widow's garments and covered herself with a veil."

questions.question: What twins did Tamar bear?
questions.explanation: Genesis 38:27-30: Tamar gave birth to twins: Perez and Zerah.

questions.question: Who was Judah's wife?
questions.explanation: Genesis 38:2: "There Judah saw the daughter of a certain Canaanite whose name was Shua. He took her and went in to her."

questions.question: Why did God put Onan to death?
options: He refused to raise offspring for his brother
questions.correctAnswer: He refused to raise offspring for his brother
questions.explanation: Genesis 38:9-10: Onan refused to fulfill his duty to raise offspring for his brother, and God put him to death.

questions.question: What pledge did Judah give Tamar?
questions.explanation: Genesis 38:18: "He said, 'What pledge shall I give you?' She replied, 'Your signet and your cord and your staff.'"

questions.question: What was Judah's initial reaction when he learned Tamar was pregnant?
options: He ordered her to be burned
questions.correctAnswer: He ordered her to be burned
questions.explanation: Genesis 38:24: "Judah said, 'Bring her out, and let her be burned.'"

questions.question: How did Tamar prove Judah was the father?
options: She showed his signet, cord, and staff
questions.correctAnswer: She showed his signet, cord, and staff
questions.explanation: Genesis 38:25: "She sent to her father-in-law, saying, 'By the man to whom these belong, I am pregnant.'"

questions.question: What did Judah say about Tamar after learning the truth?
options: She is more righteous than I
questions.correctAnswer: She is more righteous than I
questions.explanation: Genesis 38:26: "Then Judah identified them and said, 'She is more righteous than I.'"

questions.question: Why did Tamar disguise herself?
options: Because Judah withheld Shelah from her
questions.correctAnswer: Because Judah withheld Shelah from her
questions.explanation: Genesis 38:14: "For she saw that Shelah was grown up, and she had not been given to him in marriage."

questions.question: What happened at Zerah's birth?
options: A scarlet thread was tied on his hand though Perez came out first
questions.correctAnswer: A scarlet thread was tied on his hand though Perez came out first
questions.explanation: Genesis 38:28-30: The midwife tied a scarlet thread on Zerah's hand, but Perez broke through first.

questions.question: Who did Judah send to pay Tamar and retrieve his pledge?
questions.explanation: Genesis 38:20: "Judah sent the young goat by his friend the Adullamite to take back the pledge."

questions.question: Where was Tamar sitting when Judah saw her?
questions.explanation: Genesis 38:14: "She sat at the entrance to Enaim, which is on the road to Timnah."

questions.question: Why is Perez significant in biblical history?
options: He was in the lineage of David and Jesus
questions.correctAnswer: He was in the lineage of David and Jesus
questions.explanation: Perez is listed in the genealogy of David (Ruth 4:18-22) and Jesus (Matthew 1:3).

key_verse_text: Then Judah identified them and said, 'She is more righteous than I.'
